title: Verifier on padded concatenations
statement: Let $L$ be a language of binary words, let $c$ be a natural number, and let $x,u$ be binary words with $|u|=2^{(|x|+1)^c}$. Then $x$ followed by $u$ belongs to the padding verifier for $L$ at degree $c$ if and only if $x\in L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the binary alphabet
replaced:
If $|u| = 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$, then the concatenation $x \mathbin{+\!\!+} u$ belongs
to the padding verifier of $L$ at degree $c$ if and only if $x \in L$.
